title: fix: restore Polli and improve PR reviews
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restores Polli generation, visual, and repository tools after the model update; improves chart, table, and Mermaid rendering.
- Hardens contributor authorization and keeps `!polli` general-purpose with evidence-based PR review guidance.
- Fixes incomplete Discord member/role listings, enables Members intent, preserves source-channel context, and corrects message links.
- Enforces requester/bot channel permissions and public-only HTTP search scope, validates search inputs, and handles rate-limit delays.
- Adds regressions, opt-in read-only live tests, and [seven Discord verification screenshots](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/tree/d67377c55/apps/polli/docs/verification/2026-09-06). Prior local validation: 68 passed, 1 live test skipped; Black/Ruff passed. Screenshots show thread context, message/member/role search, PNG output, and Discord-to-GitHub mapping; the table PNG has visible overlap/clipping. Post-merge public-link and final verification remain pending.

gist.headline: Polli found her tools
gist.blurb: Polli has her generation tools back and a much better map of Discord. She can now follow threads, find the right messages and members, and turn charts and diagrams into things humans can actually inspect.
gist.summary: Restored Polli's generation, visual, and repository tools after the model update, while hardening Discord search, member and role listings, channel permissions, source-context links, and chart/table/Mermaid rendering.
gist.impact: Discord users and contributors get more reliable Polli reviews and lookups: thread-aware results, complete member and role searches, correct message links, safer public-only search, and improved PNG visuals.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful code reviewer in a cozy Discord garden-workshop, using a magnifying glass to trace glowing thread lines from a retro CRT terminal to a GitHub pull-request scroll. A helpful monitor robot can hold a clean chart and Mermaid diagram, while flowering code-plants represent restored tools and reliable search context.
